sources.summary: True-crime show Don’t Date Brandon is a shocker. Plus: Harriet Walter delves into her Italian family heritage in Who Do You Think You Are? Here’s what to watch this evening 10pm, Channel 4 Amber Rasmussen thought Brandon Johnson was “the full package” when they met on Tinder. They quickly got engaged but there was one problem: his “crazy ex” Athena Klingerman was apparently making wild demands. As this three-part true-crime series shows, it was – shocker! – Brandon causing all sorts of trouble. The women later teamed up to make a podcast exposing his lies.
